items.text: LA Chargers (early week, 0-8): QB Justin Herbert hurt his left (non-throwing) middle finger in Wk9, X-rays negative, Harbaugh says he 'should be good to go'. Day-to-day - WR Ladd McConkey (back spasms, did not play Wk9). Wk9 injuries - CB Isas Waxter, CB Cam Hart, DL Justin Eboigbe (all ankle). TE David Njoku and LB Denzel Perryman designated to return from IR.
items.source: ESPN (Harbaugh: X-rays on Herbert's finger negative, Nov 9)

items.text: Baltimore (early week): Jacoby Brissett (acquired from ARI) confirmed by Minter as the starter vs LAC; QB Lamar Jackson (thumb) and QB Tyler Huntley on IR; Joe Fagnano (ankle) back to backup. Monitor - S Kyle Hamilton (hip, 'looks fairly good'), CB Nate Wiggins (illness), S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee).
items.source: BaltimoreRavens.com (Hamilton update; Brissett starting vs Chargers, Nov 9)
